**.subckt top IN OUT
*.ipin IN
*.opin OUT
x1 IN mid VDD VSS inv wp=4 wn=1
x2 mid OUT VDD VSS inv wp=2 wn=1
* noconn #net1
**.ends

* expanding   symbol:  root/inv.sym # of pins=4
** sym_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/app-inv/export/root/inv.sym
** sch_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/app-inv/export/root/inv.sch
.subckt inv A Y VDD VSS  wp=2 wn=1
*.ipin A
*.opin Y
*.iopin VDD
*.iopin VSS
MM1 Y A VDD VDD pmos W='(wp)*1u' L='(0.15)*1u'
MM2 Y A VSS VSS nmos W='(wn)*1u' L='(0.15)*1u' nf=1
.ends
